note: fromRole missing — the compare-and-swap is the point of the task, so a move that does not say what it moves from must not validate.
subject is not a DID — the schema pins `^did:` so a member name or label cannot stand in for the identifier the entry is keyed by.
Empty toRole — minLength 1; an empty role would read as 'no role' to a lenient consumer.
Unknown top-level member — additionalProperties: false; an administrative role must be moved with acl/change-role, not smuggled in beside the community role.
Bare ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every ext key to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
Response without `changed` — a requester must be able to tell a no-op from a move without diffing roles.
Unknown approval value — the Approval enum is closed to policyAllowed, approved and waived.
